name: dev-null
title: /dev/null
description: Participate in the social network for devs.
author: chrismessina

commands.name: create-commit
commands.title: Create Commit
commands.subtitle: /dev/null
commands.description: Sign a commit with your SSH key and post it to /dev/null.

preferences.name: useSelectedText
preferences.title: Selected Text
preferences.label: Use selected text for new commits
preferences.description: Selected text is appended to a draft you already started.

commands.name: view-profile
commands.title: View Profile
commands.subtitle: /dev/null
commands.description: Look up someone's /dev/null profile, commits and followers, or search for people.

commands.name: my-profile
commands.title: Go to My Profile
commands.subtitle: /dev/null
commands.description: Open your own /dev/null profile, commits and followers.

commands.name: my-commits
commands.title: My Commits
commands.subtitle: /dev/null
commands.description: Browse the commits and replies you've posted to /dev/null.

tools.name: post-commit
tools.title: Post Commit
tools.description: Post a commit (a public post) to /dev/null, signed with your SSH key, with optional image attachments.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: username
preferences.title: Username
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the account of your last commit.

preferences.name: verboseLogging
preferences.title: Debug Logging
preferences.label: Enable extra diagnostics in the console
preferences.description: Show detailed logs in the console for debugging.

preferences.name: strictRedaction
preferences.title: Strict Redaction
preferences.label: Also hide URL query strings and fragments in logs
preferences.description: Turn on before reproducing an issue, then share only the new log lines.
